name: claude-code-essentials
description: Essential Claude Code plugins for developers

plugins.name: basics
plugins.description: Essential commands, agents, hooks, and skills for everyday development workflows

plugins.name: elon-algorithm
plugins.description: Run Elon's algorithm (question → delete → simplify) on any artifact to cut AI slop and make code, prompts, skills, or docs leaner and denser. Ships a reusable workflow + skill.

plugins.name: chad-review
plugins.description: Strip the showing-off from any artifact by making it survive Chad — an impatient user who only cares about the job and refuses to be impressed. Ships a reusable workflow + skill.

plugins.name: safe-push
plugins.description: Prevents accidental pushes to main branch in Claude Code bypassPermissions mode. Designed for user scope installation.
